title: EvoNext
subtitle: Enterprise GRC & BCM Platform
description:
Enterprise GRC and BCM platform used by banking clients for governance workflows, compliance operations, and continuity planning. Built and enhanced frontend modules with role-based access flows, audit reporting screens, and usability-focused UI improvements integrated with Java REST services.

Tech: React, TypeScript, Java, REST APIs

title: Interview Tracker
subtitle: Full-stack SaaS for end-to-end job search tracking
description:
AI-first job search copilot that combines application tracking, interview round management, and smart assistant workflows in one product while automating interview workflow. Generates recruiter cold emails, follow-up emails, interview questions, and resume-to-JD feedback using OpenAI and Gemini with streaming responses for a faster UX.

Tech: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Zustand, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, OpenAI, Gemini, SSE

title: Resume Analyzer (RAG)
subtitle: Skill match score + gap analysis
description:
RAG-based resume analysis app with server-side resume parsing and job description comparison. Uses semantic chunking, embeddings, and vector retrieval to surface match scores, missing skills, and resume improvement suggestions.

Tech: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, LangChain, OpenAI, Gemini, Pinecone

title: Multi-Tenant Task API
subtitle: Tenant isolation, RBAC & activity logs
description:
Production-grade multi-tenant REST API with tenant isolation, RBAC, project/task workflows, and activity logging. Designed for secure organization-level separation with scalable backend architecture and test coverage.

Tech: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Jest, Supertest

title: AI Developer Assistant
subtitle: AI-powered assistant for coding, debugging, and learning.
description:
Full-stack AI developer assistant focused on everyday coding productivity and learning support. Includes multi-mode chat (Code/Debug/Explain/Plan), context-aware responses with sliding window memory, and clean Markdown/code rendering powered by OpenAI and Gemini.

Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, OpenAI, Gemini

title: Kanban Board
subtitle: Minimalist Task Management App
description:
Minimalist bento-style Kanban board built for fast and focused task management. Implemented drag-and-drop flow, lightweight state handling, and a clean responsive UI optimized for clarity and speed.

Tech: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

title: Edutech Platform
subtitle: Learning Content Platform
description:
Learning content platform where users can create, consume, and rate educational content. Built secure user access with authentication, OTP-based login, and payment integration for controlled premium usage.

Tech: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS

title: Caprics Learning
subtitle: Ed-Tech SaaS Platform
description:
Ed-tech SaaS platform with an admin panel for managing courses and operational workflows. Built API integrations, improved admin UX, and optimized backend query performance with MongoDB aggregation pipelines.

Tech: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB
